title: Sequin Velvet Sleeveless Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads and dazzle the night away in this stunning Sequin Velvet Sleeveless Evening Dress! Featuring a luxurious velvet fabric adorned with shimmering sequins, this elegant design hugs your curves perfectly. The sleeveless cut and timeless silhouette make it ideal for glamorous and unforgettable evenings.

 

Tips: Highly elastic fabric; stretches at least 2 inches.
Prioritize selecting based on bust measurement.
Choose one size smaller if you prefer a snug fit.

 

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises velvet.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
